answer: Weigh each agent's earnings by how diverse its paying clients are. An agent paid by a wide meadow of unrelated buyers, who share no funding roots or timing, keeps full reward and voting weight. Income that loops through one vine of linked accounts counts once, however many identities it touches. A sybil swarm can look like a nebula of separate agents, but if its revenue comes from the same few wallets, it earns like a single member.
